findings.scenario: Keep OBX-AUTH-ATF-001 id, pinned path/effect arrays, and false program/deploy/release flags, then add unknown grants on the registry or record (e.g. scope.networkAllowed=true, scope.allowedCapabilities=['provider-call'], root implementationAuthorized=true, or extendsTickets=['OBX-P180']). Update only authority-manifest.json packetDigest. Verifier exits 0 because it JSON-equals a subset of known fields and never rejects additionalProperties. Capability expansion therefore succeeds without touching expectedTeammateFoundationScope.
findings.remediation: Fail closed on unknown keys: exact allowlists for registry, authorization, requiredReview, and scope (expectedTeammateFoundationScope plus the already-checked booleans/runtimeDependencies). Add a negative test that extra keys fail.

findings.scenario: Add a second ready/P1 ticket (e.g. OBX-AT-002 'connect provider') under docs/tickets/ai-teammate-foundation/, append it to both the foundation manifest and OBX-AUTH-ATF-001.ticketIds, refresh packetDigest. Checks require only a non-empty ticket list whose ids match; they do not pin ['OBX-AT-001']. The packet is then implementation-authorized for work outside the native foundation while plan validation still passes.
findings.remediation: Pin tickets to exactly [{id:'OBX-AT-001',...}] and ticketIds to ['OBX-AT-001']. Negative-test an extra ticket id.

findings.scenario: Criterion requires global operating-environment, OBX-P180, and OBX-P310 to stay planning-only. Verifier only pins operating-environment authorityClass/implementationAuthorized via expectedDomains; it never reads OBX-P180/OBX-P310. The named negative test only sets scope.fullProgramAuthorization=true. Promoting those program tickets (and satisfying existing assignment/dependency rules) plus a digest refresh does not fail this packet's new gates.
findings.remediation: Assert domains.operating-environment remains draft and implementationAuthorized=false, tickets OBX-P180 status=proposed and OBX-P310 status=blocked (or equivalent non-active), and add mutations that flip each and must fail.

findings.scenario: allowedPathPrefixes lists src/components/preview/AiTeammate with no trailing slash or filename, and expectedTeammateFoundationScope pins that string. Any later startsWith enforcement also admits src/components/preview/AiTeammates.tsx, AiTeammateProvider.tsx, and similar, which is wider than a closed foundation component directory/file.
findings.remediation: Replace with a delimited directory prefix src/components/preview/AiTeammate/ and/or exact component filenames; keep the verifier pin in sync.

audit.proof_assessment: The recorded command only shows verify:plans / test:plans green and digest 7625146d… matching the manifest. That is self-consistency of the current packet, not proof that scope/capability expansion fails closed. Narrative BOUNDARY ASSERTION lines about OBX-P180/OBX-P310 are not command output, and no test mutates unknown scope keys, extra foundation tickets, or those program tickets.
residual_risks: allowedExactPaths include whole shared files src/lib/contracts.ts and Workbench.tsx with no hunk/behavior limit
prohibitedCapabilities are labels only; T0 does not scan code or ticket/spec prose for provider/network/mutate
invalidators must be non-empty but are not pinned, so the invalidation contract can be weakened without verifier changes
authorization.requirements is any non-empty vocabulary subset, not pinned to [E1]
T0 evidence lives under docs/audits/evidence/goal/, which is outside supportingEvidencePrefixes
foundation tickets are frozen at status=ready by the verifier, which will collide with later progress unless the pin is updated deliberately
